cases.notes: Ukraine is the recognized baseline; Russia is recorded separately as controlling power where relevant. Avoid presenting the small-scale default map as a legal or diplomatic boundary determination.
Treat the West Bank and Gaza as distinguishable where scale supports it; terminology and classification are the primary policy surface.
Handle naming, separate control, and classification explicitly without implying universal recognition.
Represent the dispute between India, Pakistan, and China through metadata and coarse display guidance unless a later reviewed feature adds precise segment geometry.
Keep representation explicitly reviewable because sovereignty remains disputed and the territory is treated through the United Nations decolonization framework.
Review naming and depiction together rather than silently adopting a single recognition model.
Deferred expansion candidate. Do not change depiction silently because representation is recognition-sensitive.
